title: Install Node.js
summary: Node lets you run JavaScript files outside the browser.

steps.instruction: Open https://nodejs.org and download the LTS installer for Windows. LTS means the stable long-term version.
steps.expectedResult: An installer file is in your Downloads folder.

steps.instruction: Run the installer. Leave the defaults, including the option that adds Node to your PATH.
Close any old terminals. Open a new one and check the version.
steps.expectedResult: A version prints, such as v22.x.x. If you see “not recognized”, close the terminal and open a brand new one.

steps.instruction: Confirm npm (the package installer that comes with Node) works too.
